exposure: Collaborative and transparent physician privilege review process
outcome: Reduction in approved surgical procedures (from 558 to 321)
Prevention of cases exceeding hospital capabilities
cohort: The study involves the physicians and multidisciplinary staff at Martin Luther King, Jr. Community Hospital who participated in the review of physician privileges.
finding: A collaborative, transparent process successfully reduced the scope of surgical practice at a new safety-net community hospital, preventing cases that exceeded the hospital's capabilities and fostering buy-in among stakeholders.
